mapper.select: SELECT LANG_CD, LANG_NM, NATIVE_NM, IMPLEMENTED_YN, USE_YN, SORT_ORD FROM ju_language WHERE USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY SORT_ORD, LANG_CD

SELECT g.GRP_CD, COALESCE(ml.RES_VAL, d.GRP_NM, g.GRP_CD) AS GRP_NM, COALESCE(md.RES_VAL, d.GRP_DESC) AS GRP_DESC, g.SORT_ORD FROM ju_com_group g LEFT JOIN ju_com_group_detail d ON d.GRP_CD = g.GRP_CD LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang ml ON ml.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND ml.RES_KEY = d.GRP_NM_KEY LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang md ON md.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND md.RES_KEY = d.GRP_DESC_KEY WHERE g.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY g.SORT_ORD, g.GRP_CD

SELECT c.GRP_CD, c.COM_CD, c.COM_VAL, c.COM_ATTR, COALESCE(ml.RES_VAL, d.COM_NM, c.COM_CD) AS COM_NM, COALESCE(md.RES_VAL, d.COM_DESC) AS COM_DESC, c.SORT_ORD FROM ju_com_code c LEFT JOIN ju_com_code_detail d ON d.GRP_CD = c.GRP_CD AND d.COM_CD = c.COM_CD LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang ml ON ml.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND ml.RES_KEY = d.COM_NM_KEY LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang md ON md.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND md.RES_KEY = d.COM_DESC_KEY WHERE c.GRP_CD = #{grpCd} AND c.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY c.SORT_ORD, c.COM_CD

SELECT m.MNU_ID, m.MNU_CD, m.UP_MNU_ID, m.MNU_KIND, m.MNU_LV, m.MNU_URL, m.SORT_ORD, COALESCE(ml.RES_VAL, d.MNU_NM, m.MNU_CD) AS MNU_NM, COALESCE(md.RES_VAL, d.MNU_DESC) AS MNU_DESC FROM ju_menu m LEFT JOIN ju_menu_detail d ON d.MNU_ID = m.MNU_ID LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang ml ON ml.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND ml.RES_KEY = d.MNU_NM_KEY LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang md ON md.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND md.RES_KEY = d.MNU_DESC_KEY WHERE m.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' AND m.ENABLED_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY m.SORT_ORD, m.MNU_ID
SELECT d.*, x.DEV_NM, x.DEV_DESC, x.DEV_CONFIG, x.DEV_EXTRA, x.DEV_DATA FROM ju_device d LEFT JOIN ju_device_detail x ON x.DEV_CD = d.DEV_CD WHERE d.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY d.DEV_CD
SELECT g.*, d.DAT_GR_NM, d.DAT_GR_DESC FROM ju_data_group g LEFT JOIN ju_data_group_detail d ON d.DAT_GR_CD = g.DAT_GR_CD WHERE g.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY g.SORT_ORD, g.DAT_GR_CD

SELECT t.*, d.DAT_NM, d.DAT_DESC, d.TAG_KIND, d.TAG_COLOR, d.DAT_MIN, d.DAT_MAX, d.FORMULA_YN, d.FORMULA_CNT, d.FORMULA_ITEM, d.DAT_FORMULA, d.FORMULA_MIN, d.FORMULA_MAX, d.FORMULA_UNIT FROM ju_data_tag t LEFT JOIN ju_data_tag_detail d ON d.DAT_GR_CD = t.DAT_GR_CD AND d.DAT_CD = t.DAT_CD AND d.DAT_IDX = t.DAT_IDX WHERE t.DAT_GR_CD = #{datGrCd} AND t.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY t.SORT_ORD, t.DAT_IDX

SELECT e.*, d.EXP_NM, d.EXP_DESC, d.EXP_TIME, d.EXP_INTVAL, d.EXP_CONFIG, d.RUN_MODE, d.START_DT, d.END_DT, d.EXP_EXTRA FROM ju_experiment e LEFT JOIN ju_experiment_detail d ON d.EXP_ID = e.EXP_ID WHERE e.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY e.EXP_ID
